subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to a full local date/time display, and should maintainers adopt or replace the open fork PR that attempts it?
rationale: This is a user-facing Control UI display policy choice with an existing conflicting fork implementation, so automation should not queue a second fix until maintainers choose the desired UX and PR path.

options.title: Adopt the full-date display
options.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, either by rebasing the fork PR or opening an equivalent replacement.

options.title: Keep relative display
options.body: Close the linked implementation path and this feature request if maintainers prefer compact relative Updated values for the session list.

options.title: Defer to table redesign
options.body: Keep the issue open only as part of a broader Sessions table UX pass if maintainers do not want a one-off column change now.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full-date display
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow full local date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, either by rebasing the fork PR or opening an equivalent replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the most recent current-main ownership signal for the Sessions page and Control UI table behavior.
